translations.web: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.
translations.bsb: On that day the prince shall provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.
translations.kjv: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
translations.asv: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin-offering.
